csv_project_name: DB for New River Terrance Recreation Center
csv_agency: Government DC, Department of General Services
csv_scope_of_work: The District of Columbia (the District ) Department of General Services (the Department or DGS ) is issuing this Request for Proposals ( RFP ) to solicit design-build proposals ( Proposal(s) ) from offerors ( Offeror(s) ) interested in serving as the design-builder (the Design-Builder or the Contractor ) for the New River Terrace Recreation Center located in Ward 7 at 500 36th Street NE, Washington, DC 20019 (the Project ). The Design-Builder shall design and construct the New River Terrace Recreation Center to meet the growing needs of the New River Terrace Recreation Center and the community. The designbuild team shall deliver a complete, fully operational, code-compliant public facility that supports community programing, recreation, fitness, technology access, and exterior amenities.

title: Design-Build for New River Terrace Recreation Center

project_scope: Design and construction of the New River Terrace Recreation Center in Ward 7 as a complete, fully operational, code-compliant public facility. services: Design-build services including architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, and geotechnical engineering for the full delivery of the recreation center.
relevance_explanation:
- Recreation center building project with integrated design-build scope.

- Building type is moderately relevant to sbp, but less aligned than bridges, stadiums, or special long-span structures.
